label: Сын
description: Twelve-mission case drill for сын (son) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form сын has a zero ending and names the subject. Here сын is the one who studies, so it stands in the nominative as the grammatical subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The nominative сын adds -а to become сына. The word нет signalling absence governs the genitive, so the son the neighbour lacks appears as сына.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. The ending shifts to -у, giving сыну. The verb купить marks the beneficiary with the dative, so сыну is the one for whom the bicycle was bought.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of любить takes the accusative, but because сын is animate, the accusative copies the genitive: сына. Animacy is why the form ends in -а rather than staying сын.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The ending becomes -ом, producing сыном. The verb гордиться governs the instrumental, marking сыном as the source of the pride.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The ending is -е, giving сыне. The preposition о meaning about forces the prepositional, the case for the object of care described.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural is irregular: the stem expands to сыновь- and takes -я, giving сыновья. As the subject of the description, they stand in the nominative.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The irregular soft stem сыновь- takes -ей, giving сыновей. The numeral пятеро governs the genitive plural, so the counted sons appear as сыновей.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The expanded stem сыновья- takes the dative ending -ям, producing сыновьям. The recipients of the letters stand in the dative.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The direct object would be accusative, but animacy makes the accusative plural copy the genitive plural: сыновей. The form matches the genitive, not the nominative сыновья, because the noun is animate.

missions.phrase: Отец рыбачит с сыновьями каждое лето.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The expanded stem сыновья- takes -ями, giving сыновьями. The preposition с meaning with requires the instrumental, naming сыновьями as the fishing companions.

Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The expanded stem сыновья- takes the prepositional ending -ях, giving сыновьях. The preposition о meaning about governs the prepositional, marking сыновьях as the topic.
